05-order-history.name: 05-order-history
05-order-history.title: Find a placed order under Account → Orders

steps.heading: Add a product to the cart
steps.detail:
Added the "Ink Sampler" to the cart as requested.
Confirmed that the cart badge in the header shows 1 item.
The task was completed successfully.

steps.heading: Place an order
steps.detail:
Opened the cart and proceeded to the checkout page.
Entered the requested payment and contact details, then submitted the payment.
The order was confirmed successfully with order number INK-47133.

steps.heading: Find the order under Account → Orders
steps.detail:
The agent clicked the Inkwell Supply Co. store-name link as though it were an Account menu. That link returned it to the home page, and the later Cart action returned it to checkout. Neither action could open an Orders page.
Update the test to require a known account-enabled fixture and a real Account/Orders locator. If this storefront is intended to provide order history, document that requirement separately and test the feature directly. (Checked home and checkout pages; neither exposes an Account menu, link, or Orders page.)

bugVerdict.title: Brand link mistaken for Account menu
bugVerdict.oneLiner: The run failed because it treated the store name as an Account menu even though the visible header only offered the store link and Cart.
